name: Hubble USDH
oneLiner: USDH is Hubble Protocol's decentralized CDP stablecoin on Solana, minted against SOL, mSOL, BTC, ETH and other whitelisted assets at 150% min collateral ratio.
collateral: Overcollateralized basket of Solana-native crypto assets (SOL, mSOL, BTC, ETH, and other Hubble-whitelisted tokens) deposited into Hubble Protocol CDP vaults at a minimum 150% collateralization ratio
pegMechanism: Borrowers mint USDH against overcollateralized Solana crypto vaults and repay or are liquidated under Hubble's CDP rules; Stability Pool absorbs liquidations and distributes collateral to depositors

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed No: Hubble USDH is a Solana CDP debt token backed by borrower vault collateral and Stability Pool liquidations; reviewed docs do not identify a holder-balance blacklist, freeze, or arbitrary burn path on USDH itself.
blacklistabilityReview.upstreamSuppressionRationale: The reviewed override is scoped to the USDH holder-facing token. Hubble docs describe a crypto-collateral CDP vault system, so this override deliberately suppresses inferred upstream freeze exposure from generic BTC/ETH/stablecoin text signals.

reserves.name: Hubble Protocol overcollateralized Solana crypto vaults (SOL, mSOL, BTC, ETH and other whitelisted assets)

notices.title: Symbol collision on Solana
notices.message: The 'USDH' symbol is also used on Solana by Native Markets and Hermetica — distinct issuers with separate collateral models. This entry tracks the original Hubble Protocol USDH.

notices.title: Small float, dormant trading
notices.message: Hubble's USDH circulating supply has contracted to roughly $1.2–1.5M with very low secondary-market volume. The Hubble team's focus has shifted to sister protocol Kamino, though no formal USDH wind-down has been announced and the borrow app remains operational.

mintAuthority.summary: USDH is Hubble Protocol's MakerDAO-style CDP stablecoin on Solana: borrowers mint USDH against overcollateralized whitelisted SOL/mSOL/BTC/ETH vaults at a 150% minimum ratio, with the HBB governance process administering collateral whitelisting and parameters.

controls.label: Hubble borrowing-market program (USDH mint authority)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by overcollateralized CDP vaults at a 150% minimum collateral ratio against whitelisted Solana assets.
controls.evidence: Hubble docs describe USDH as a CDP debt token minted by depositing whitelisted Solana collateral into borrowing-market vaults at a 150% minimum ratio; the USDH SPL mint authority is held by the Hubble program.

controls.label: Hubble governance (HBB / collateral whitelisting + program admin)
controls.evidence: Hubble docs describe collateral asset whitelisting and parameter control via the HBB governance process (transitioning toward a fully autonomous/immutable Hubble 2.0); the program upgrade/admin authority is not independently confirmed.

review.evidence: Hubble Protocol documentation describes USDH as a Solana MakerDAO-style overcollateralized CDP with HBB-token governance and collateral whitelisting; the on-chain USDH mint authority and Hubble program upgrade authority were not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the USDH SPL mint authority and the Hubble borrowing-market program upgrade authority on a Solana explorer (multisig vs. program-derived).
Confirm whether the documented Hubble 2.0 immutability transition has occurred for the live borrow app.
